source: 本轮狩猎箱与碎片菜单采集的完整有序 Lore

lines.raw: §8§oChuckwallas cram themselves into the smallest of crevices to avoid predators, inflating their lungs to make themselves harder to dislodge.
lines.text: Chuckwallas cram themselves into the smallest of crevices to avoid predators, inflating their lungs to make themselves harder to dislodge.
lines.zh: 为了躲避天敌, Chuckwalla 会钻进最窄的岩缝,再鼓足气撑住两壁,任谁也难把它拽出来。

lines.raw: §8§oHideonwalls are somehow capable of intangibility, allowing for them to live within walls. Yes - they are in your walls.
lines.text: Hideonwalls are somehow capable of intangibility, allowing for them to live within walls. Yes - they are in your walls.
lines.zh: Hideonwall 不知怎么学会了让身体变得无形,从此便住进了墙里。没错,也包括你家的墙。

lines.raw: §8§oIt collects shiny things, such as gemstones, and attempts to bring them back to its nest.
lines.text: It collects shiny things, such as gemstones, and attempts to bring them back to its nest.
lines.zh: 它喜欢收集宝石之类亮闪闪的东西,还会想方设法把它们搬回窝里。

lines.raw: §8§oIts growl echoes through the cavernous depths, a chilling sound that signals imminent danger to any who dare enter its territory.
lines.text: Its growl echoes through the cavernous depths, a chilling sound that signals imminent danger to any who dare enter its territory.
lines.zh: 它的低吼回荡在洞窟深处。胆敢闯入它领地的人一听到这令人脊背发凉的声音,就知道危险近在眼前。

lines.raw: §8§oIts very presence warps reality around it, bending the laws of nature to its will and spreading chaos and despair wherever it treads.
lines.text: Its very presence warps reality around it, bending the laws of nature to its will and spreading chaos and despair wherever it treads.
lines.zh: 它光是站在那里,周遭的现实就会扭曲。自然法则任它摆布,所到之处只余混乱与绝望。

lines.raw: §8§oRevenants emit an aura of death and decay, sapping the life force of those who dare to confront them.
lines.text: Revenants emit an aura of death and decay, sapping the life force of those who dare to confront them.
lines.zh: 亡魂身上散发着死亡与腐朽的气息,敢与它们对峙的人会被一点点抽走生机。

lines.raw: §8§oThe Billygoat stands alone atop the summit of the tallest mountain. Nothing else comes close and, should it try to, it'll be sent back to earth courtesy of a particularly harsh headbutt.
lines.text: The Billygoat stands alone atop the summit of the tallest mountain. Nothing else comes close and, should it try to, it'll be sent back to earth courtesy of a particularly harsh headbutt.
lines.zh: 最高的山巅只立着一头公山羊。谁敢凑近,它就一头狠狠顶过去,送对方回山脚。

lines.raw: §8§oThe Hideyho is capable of perfectly imitating any living creature it comes into contact with, and often uses this unique ability to cause mischief.
lines.text: The Hideyho is capable of perfectly imitating any living creature it comes into contact with, and often uses this unique ability to cause mischief.
lines.zh: 只要接触过, Hideyho 就能把任何生物模仿得惟妙惟肖。它最爱拿这身本事捉弄人。

lines.raw: §8§oThese undead creatures are driven by an insatiable greed, forever seeking out precious metals and jewels.
lines.text: These undead creatures are driven by an insatiable greed, forever seeking out precious metals and jewels.
lines.zh: 这些亡灵永远也填不满自己的贪欲,无休无止地搜寻着贵金属和珠宝。
